shots.camText: Opens exactly on Q07's last frame: her seated close-up · 65 mm · handheld
shots.note: Her smile fades; the paper bag comes into the edge of frame beside her face, hanging from his hand; she turns her head away from it and swallows.

shots.camText: Low two-shot from the kerb, near the ground · 28 mm · locked-off
shots.note: Oren stands beside her, towering, facing the street; the bag hangs from his LEFT hand right beside her turned-away face; people pass behind.

shots.camText: Close-up of Helena seated · 65 mm · handheld

lines.text: HELENA: You got somewhere to be?

shots.note: Her eyes on the street, then up to him; dry.

shots.camText: Low angle up at Oren from beside her, below her seated eye line · 35 mm · locked-off
shots.line: OREN: "Yes. I am delivering this to my client at the clinic. Her daughter is with her."

lines.text: OREN: Yes. I am delivering this to my client at the clinic. Her daughter is with her.

shots.note: Even, plain; the grey sky behind him.

shots.camText: Close on Helena listening, the bag soft at the edge of frame · 50 mm · handheld
shots.line: OREN (off): "It needs to arrive by two."

lines.text: OREN (off): It needs to arrive by two.

shots.note: Her lips closed, jaw tight, eyes on the street; the deadline lands on her face.

shots.camText: Low angle up at Oren from beside her, below her seated eye line · 35 mm · locked-off
shots.line: OREN: "I can assist you, provided it still arrives on time."

lines.text: OREN: I can assist you, provided it still arrives on time.

shots.note: He looks down at her; then still.
